title: What the Honey Badger brings

is_this_you.pressure: Trouble shows up and you walk straight at it. Your hands start shaking an hour later, after everyone has gone home.
is_this_you.love: You fall in a weekend and stay for years. A partner's bad day gets more of your nerve than your own ever does.
is_this_you.cost: You are back on your feet so fast that nobody thinks to bring the soup.

opener.text: In Chinese, the word for badger, 獾 (huān), sounds exactly like 欢 (huān), joy [chinasage]. Two badgers, 双獾 (shuānghuān), read as a married couple's shared joy [chinasage] [woolley]. That is a lot of happiness to hang on the animal Guinness once named the most fearless in the world [sanbi]. It fits anyway. You were born an Aries in the year of the Pig, and you fight like you are having the best day of your life.

howto: Three parts. Hit one. Hit them all.

tabs.label: Fearless
tabs.intro: Fire that charges, Water that stays.

rows.text: Aries is cardinal Fire, ruled by Mars, the first sign of the year and the first one through the door [wiki-aries] [tap-aries]. The Pig is yin Water, calm under pressure and highly focused [wiki-pig] [chinahighlights-pig]. Water controls Fire, so the Pig sits on the Ram like a lid on a pot [wiki-pig] [wiki-aries]. You start the fight fast. Then you do what most Aries never manage. You stay for the end of it.

rows.k: The honey badger does it too
rows.text: A honey badger's skin is thick and loose around the neck [adw] [wiki-hb]. A predator that grabs it gets a mouthful of coat, while the badger twists round inside and bites [adw]. Get hold of you and you twist too. It works far more often than it should.

The Pig rarely asks for help [chinahighlights-pig]. So you get up before anyone saw you fall. The Pig is also easy to fool, because it rarely suspects a con [chinahighlights-pig]. Watch whoever praises how tough you are. They usually have something heavy for you to carry.

In Chinese paintings the badger usually sits under a magpie, 喜鹊 (xǐquè), the bird of joy [chinasage]. A magpie flying over a badger means happiness in heaven and on earth [chinasage]. Your happiness lives lower and louder. A fight won, then a long dinner with the people you would bleed for.

Alibaba named its chip company 平头哥 (píngtóugē), flat-head brother, after the honey badger, for its spirit of forging ahead against the odds [labbrand]. Send yourself where others back out. Emergency rooms, fire crews and failing companies all need someone who walks in.

tabs.label: Who stands with you
tabs.intro: Three who fight on your side, and one who argues first.
tabs.love_lead: In love you show up with your sleeves rolled. You fall at Aries speed and then stay put. Pick someone who can tell a fast recovery from a wound that never happened. The old Chinese pairings give you three allies.

easy.why: The Wolverine (Aries, Tiger year) is your secret friend, since the Tiger is the Pig's hidden ally, and it shares your Aries sun [brief].
The Flying Fish (Sagittarius, Rabbit year) sits in your trine of Rabbit, Goat and Pig, and Sagittarius burns with the same Fire [brief] [wiki-aries].
The Golden Brushtail Possum (Leo, Goat year) closes the trine, and Leo is a fellow Fire sign [brief] [wiki-aries].

hard.why: Expect sparks with the Paradise Tanager: the Snake clashes with the Pig, and Libra sits opposite Aries, so you want to move while it wants to weigh [brief] [wiki-aries].

story.text: In 2015 researchers showed that honey badgers, hedgehogs and pigs each evolved the same change in the nerve receptor that snake venom attacks [drabeck2015]. The animal of your birth year carries the same shield. Of course it does.

closing: Somewhere a snake is having second thoughts about you. Grin, and finish your lunch.
